title: A Workflow call refuses placeholder args, and a script that reads args asserts their shape before its first agent
why: Mistake made twice in normal work (building-mistake-names-its-guard).
note: Coordinator 14:48 CST Nov 10: twice today a workflow ran with a placeholder string as its args ("FACT_CLOSE_PLACEHOLDER", then "__FILL__"), so its agents checked nothing and returned an empty or useless result. Guard: a PreToolUse check refuses a Workflow call whose args value is an ALL-CAPS or __X__ placeholder; a workflow script that reads args asserts their shape before its first agent. The coordinator's fix for that run was a shape assert at the top of the script.
